text: UBS Group AG is a SIX/NYSE-listed bank with a broad free float and no state shareholder; the Swiss Confederation exited its crisis-era stake long ago. Its 20-F discusses 'significant shareholders' only in the sense of reporting-threshold disclosures by private investors. The Mercedes partnership is private bank money.
